pr_title: Show custom pattern brushes for Paint Bucket
pr_body:
This PR makes the brushes selector available when the user selects the paint bucket tool. This way the user can fill areas with patterns without first changing to another tool to select such brush.

Fix #4053

issue_context.title: Show custom brushes/patterns for Paint Bucket
issue_context.body: From #2528, it would make sense to show the button to show custom brushes to fill with patterns with the Paint Bucket tool.

review_comments: To avoid confusion for the user, I'd leave only this change and keep the brush popup just as it looks when other tools are selected (and avoid hiding elements).
Despite being a much easier fix I have the need of asking: What about disabling the brushes instead of hiding them?

I thought about the same but I don't know if it worth it. Just in case we need a way to go back to a plain brush to fill with solid colors (not sure if that was the case with this patch, the regular/solid brush types must be visible).

There are plans to redesign this popup in the future anyway (#3219) so probably doesn't worth the effort.
